'''Camp Kote''' was owned by the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] on [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] and was commanded by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Vherr]]. [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|A Jedi Knight]] infiltrated the camp during the [[Skirmish on Carlac]] and defeated Vherr.
